name: Singapore Land Group Limited
summary: Singapore Land Group Limited operates as an investment holding company with diverse interests across Singapore and global markets. Its primary focus lies in the real estate sector, involving the development, leasing, and management of commercial office spaces, retail properties, and residential units. The company further expands its portfolio through investments in and the operation of hotels and retail centers. Beyond property, it maintains a significant presence in the technology industry, handling the distribution and retail of computer hardware and software, and delivering information technology, systems integration, and networking infrastructure solutions. Additional ventures include equity investments and providing marketing management services. Established in Singapore in 1963, Singapore Land Group Limited is a subsidiary of UOL Group Limited.
